FRI1714
videos.overview: It's our twelfth "To Catch A Predator" investigation and this time we're set up in a 6,000- square foot home in Bowling Green, Kentucky. It's a town of about 50,000 people an hour north of Nashville, Tennessee. Each one of these investigations has its own rhythm and Kentucky is no different. Within hours I am struck by the fact that fewer men are showing up at our hidden camera house than in past investigations. Looking back I think this at least partially because the Kentucky Attorney General's office and the Kentucky Bureau of Investigation, along with local law enforcement, have been actively pursuing online predators in the past year. Before Dateline's investigation in Bowling Green, the Attorney General's office with the help of the online watchdog group Perverted Justice had conducted two previous sting operations without us, making 20 arrests. One of them was a 59-year old criminal justice instructor at an Ohio college who used to be an elementary school teacher.

videos.overview: A small Texas town is shattered when beloved teacher Manuela Allen vanishes from her home in the middle of the night. When a gruesome discovery is made a short time later at a local lake, investigators are left with more questions than answers.

videos.title: Bethany Vanished
videos.overview: When a young pregnant mother goes missing in Virginia, her family embarks on a frantic search, but the case eventually goes cold; years later, investigators speak with a woman who tells a harrowing story and may hold the key to solving the case.

videos.title: 65 Seconds
videos.overview: After an apparent home invasion in Minnesota leaves Heidi Firkus dead and her husband Nick hospitalized, detectives learn the young couple was facing financial troubles.

videos.title: Dangerous Secret
videos.overview: A small Ohio town is left in shock after a local coal miner is found fatally shot in the basement of his home. As investigators dig into his personal life, a secret affair reveals a surprising suspect.

videos.title: On the Hunt for the Zombie Hunter
videos.overview: The murders of two young women near a Phoenix canal remain unsolved for over 20 years until a team of cold case detectives take on the case and investigate a man known as the Zombie Hunter.

videos.title: Ghost Rider
videos.overview: After a nurse and mother-of-three is murdered inside her Illinois home, investigators uncover security camera footage that could be key to solving the case.

videos.title: The Case of the Man With No Name
videos.overview: The investigation into the mysterious disappearance of a Canadian man sparks an international manhunt for an elusive killer with multiple false identities.

videos.title: The End of the Affair
videos.overview: After police discover the burned body of a missing Miami man at the edge of the Florida Everglades, the wife of a local supermarket mogul comes forward to reveal a shocking secret and possible lead.

videos.title: The Hunt for the Gilgo Beach Killer
videos.overview: An investigation into the murders of several women found dead along Gilgo Beach in Long Island, N.Y.

videos.title: Part of the Plan
videos.overview: Las Vegas detectives investigate the fatal shooting of a U.S. Air Force Airman.

videos.title: The Murdaugh Murders: Inside the Investigation
videos.overview: Lead detectives break their silence on the investigation into once-prominent South Carolina attorney Alex Murdaugh.

videos.title: The Ultimate Betrayal
videos.overview: After Tahereh Ghassemi disappears from the Louisiana home she shares with her adult son, detectives discover that she'd recently come into a great deal of money; the investigation reveals an astonishing plot with international implications.

videos.title: The Day Alissa Disappeared
videos.overview: When 17-year-old Alissa Turney is reported missing in Phoenix, it takes years before detectives treat her case as a homicide; a new investigation unearths dark family secrets.

videos.title: Open Desert
videos.overview: When 16-year-old Britney Ujlaky disappears, a small town in Nevada bands together to track down a potential suspect - an unknown cowboy; Soon, their focus turns to someone much closer to Britney.

videos.title: The Last Weekend
videos.overview: After trumpet player Scott Sessions fails to show up for a scheduled gig, his family learns his body was abandoned in the remote Colorado Rockies; as the investigation narrows in on two suspects, a second murder catches police by surprise.

videos.title: Down the Basement Stairs
videos.overview: When a young mother and paramedic, Annamarie Cochrane Rintala, is found dead at the bottom of her stairs, it takes four trials and 13 years before justice is served.

videos.title: The Room Downstairs
videos.overview: While responding to a house fire in New Jersey, firefighters discover the burned remains of homeowner Rob Cantor in the basement, leading investigators to question what really happened: new interviews and legal developments about the latest twists and turns in the case.

videos.title: A Promise to Gloria
videos.overview: A mother searches for answers in the unsolved murder of her 14-year-old daughter until new DNA technology changes everything.

videos.title: Ghosts Can't Talk
videos.overview: When deadly gunfire erupts in an Austin, Texas, home in the middle of the night, detectives wonder if the homeowners' jewelry business is a possible motive; an investigation uncovers a suspect that no one saw coming.

videos.title: Family Matters
videos.overview: New details on the latest twist in the murder-for-hire plot involving a prominent Florida family that left law professor Dan Markel dead and a grandmother arrested.

videos.title: The Sleepover
videos.overview: Navy petty officer and devoted mother Sherri Malarik is found shot to death in her minivan after she disappeared. The case remains cold until new revelations and old memories resurface, dividing the Florida family.

videos.title: Death at the Spa
videos.overview: Law enforcement investigates possible motives after a package explodes at a Southern California day spa, leaving a beloved esthetician dead.

videos.title: The Perfect Life
videos.overview: A mystery looms over a small New York town when a woman is murdered and a stunning secret is exposed; more than a decade later, new developments lead to an unexpected conclusion.

videos.title: The Secret in Black Rock Canyon
videos.overview: A series of mysterious events haunt 16-year-old Cassie Jo Stoddart while housesitting, and days later, she's found stabbed to death; police retrace her last day and uncover a stockpile of evidence pointing right to her killers.

videos.title: True Confession
videos.overview: After more than 20 years, the real killer of Idaho teen Angie Dodge is caught; a chilling twist in the story of Chris Tapp who had been wrongfully convicted in the case. Keith Morrison reports.

videos.title: A Life Interrupted
videos.overview: New interviews and never-before-seen evidence about the murder of Jennifer Dulos, including video and photos from residential security systems and urban police cameras that detail the timeline of the crime.

videos.title: The Killer on Camera 4
videos.overview: When a firefighter is murdered, the investigation unravels a web of secrets, a love triangle and stunning surveillance footage. Dennis Murphy reports.

videos.title: Deadly Swap
videos.overview: After a 25-year-old mother is gunned down in broad daylight by a murderer wearing a disguise, detectives confront a most unlikely suspect. Dennis Murphy reports.

videos.title: A Girl Named Egypt
videos.overview: Twenty-seven-year-old Egypt Covington is found murdered in her home; investigators in Michigan quickly identify a person of interest but years pass without an arrest.

videos.title: The Night Time Stopped
videos.overview: New details and interviews about the murder of a professional cyclist.

videos.title: Justice for Joy
videos.overview: When Joy Hibbs is found dead in a fire, an autopsy shows she was murdered beforehand. The case went cold for years, until decades later, a shocking secret is revealed. Blayne Alexander reports.

videos.title: Evil Walked Through the Door
videos.overview: The separate murders of two women in Toronto ignite an investigation that spans four decades, taking detectives from the big city to a remote, northern town.

videos.title: Chameleon
videos.overview: A woman goes missing and investigators uncover her husband's chilling history including dark secrets about another missing wife.

videos.title: If These Walls Could Talk
videos.overview: In Southern California, initial signs point to an accidental fall down a staircase as the cause of Susann Sills's death in 2016. Does the evidence disprove her husband's story?

videos.title: Sound and Fury
videos.overview: When the wife of a popular DJ is found murdered, detectives try to unravel what led to her killing.

videos.title: The Girl With the Hibiscus Tattoo
videos.overview: A group of women help bring down a smooth-talking serial predator turned killer who lured young women with promises of fame and fortune.

videos.title: Dark Intentions
videos.overview: Two women are murdered in the same Arlington, Texas apartment complex, and police are stumped. Years later, evidence from two subsequent rapes provides a breakthrough. Andrea Canning reports.

videos.title: The Breakup
videos.overview: When a nurse is gunned down in her home, detectives initially believe they have a clear suspect, but new information leads them down a completely different path. Josh Mankiewicz reports.

videos.title: The Day Akia Disappeared
videos.overview: In May 2017, 22-year-old 8-months-pregnant single mom Akia Egglestion vanishes before her own baby shower and her worried family raises the alarm; Baltimore, MD detectives unravel a chilling mystery.

videos.title: The Shadow in the Window
videos.overview: A family is rocked when a fatal accident reveals itself to be something much more disturbing.

videos.title: The Butterfly
videos.overview: A young Fairfield, Ohio, woman, 21-year-old Katelyn Markham, vanishes one summer night in 2011, prompting her community to conduct a massive search. When her skeletal remains are found in Indiana two years later, investigators question her friends and family to uncover her killer, but it takes 12 years and a detective with dogged determination.

videos.title: Wrong Turns
videos.overview: A new father is found dead on the side of a road. Then the stabbing of a young woman leads police on a high speed chase. Could these two chilling murders be connected? Josh Mankiewicz reports.

videos.title: Down the Rabbit Hole
videos.overview: In Humble, Texas, a frantic 911 caller, 16-year-old Keri Murphy, reports hearing her mother's screams after an intruder entered their home. When first responders arrive, they find Mary Ann Murphy dead after receiving more than 70 stab wounds. What happened on that dark summer night?

videos.title: The Night of the Nor'easter
videos.overview: A monster storm had rolled into Canton, Massachusetts, and Karen Read's boyfriend, police officer John O'Keefe, was dead, his body discovered in front of another officer's house. Karen was charged with John's death. Was she to blame?

videos.title: Deadly Omission
videos.overview: In Marietta, Georgia, a woman's murder shines a light on an unsolved mystery from years earlier. As the connection between the two cases becomes clear, a long-hidden truth surfaces. Could a master manipulator be behind both crimes? Andrea Canning reports.

videos.title: After the Halloween Party
videos.overview: After a 2011 Halloween party at a country club in Dyersburg, Tennessee, Karen Swift, a wife and mother of four, vanishes. Nearly a decade later, a private investigator claims to uncover chilling new clues that turn the town upside down.

videos.title: The Menendez Brothers: Chance at Freedom
videos.overview: Latest developments and new interviews in the high-profile murder trial of Lyle and Erik Menendez; a scripted show reignites public interest in the case.

videos.title: Deadly Dance
videos.overview: Dubbed the 'Black Swan' case, a former ballerina falls in love with a man 30 years her senior, but when their love story spirals out of control, one of them winds up dead.

videos.title: The Killer Among Them
videos.overview: Millionaire entrepreneur Lance Herndon is found bludgeoned to death in his Atlanta home. The search for his killer reveals no shortage of suspects or secrets.

videos.title: The Man of Many Faces
videos.overview: Andrea Canning reports on the dramatic updates in the case of international fugitive Nicholas Rossi who faked his death as law enforcement closed in on him for alleged crimes of rape and fraud; will the man with multiple identities finally face justice?

videos.title: A Little Patch of Perfect
videos.overview: After Gary "Big Daddy" Farris mysteriously disappears, his family discovers his remains on their sprawling 10-acre estate. An investigation reveals a family deeply divided by jealousy and greed, but did one of them kill Big Daddy?

videos.title: Deadly Mirage
videos.overview: When Rob Limon is murdered at work, the investigation uncovers deep secrets about sex, friendship, religion and family; the broadcast explores the case featured in its chart-topping podcast "Deadly Mirage."

videos.title: The Devil Wore White
videos.overview: An elderly socialite is reported missing from her stately New York City brownstone. When Sante Kimes and her son Kenny are arrested, an investigation reveals decades of crime, deception, and murder that captivated the nation.

videos.title: Under the Bay Bridge
videos.overview: Bob Lee was a well-known tech visionary whose sudden and brutal death in 2023 left the tech world in shock. Family, friends, attorneys, police, and colleagues from the tech industry speak out exclusively to Dateline’s Josh Mankiewicz about the case.

videos.title: Return to the Lake
videos.overview: 30 years later... On October 25, 1994, Susan Smith reported that her two young sons had been taken by a carjacker. Everyone was looking for the two young brothers. For nine days, hearts went out to their poor parents. What came next was unimaginable.

videos.title: A Walk Through the Woods
videos.overview: The high-profile case of two murdered Indiana teens takes a stunning turn after video of the killer, taken by one of his victims shortly before their deaths, is revealed.

videos.title: The Haunted House Confession
videos.overview: On Friday the 13th, 25-year-old Chantay Blankinship doesn't come home from her usual walk around the neighborhood. Two days later, searchers make a gruesome discovery at an abandoned farmhouse that locals call the Haunted House. When all leads dry up, investigators turn to a unique forensic DNA tool, which sparks a shocking confession during a church service.

videos.title: Lori Vallow Daybell: The Jailhouse Interview
videos.overview: Lori and Chad Daybell were both convicted in separate trials for the gruesome killings of two of Lori’s children in 2019. Now, Lori breaks her silence in a shocking new interview from prison.

videos.title: Deadly Entanglement
videos.overview: In 2013, Desiree Sunford is found murdered in her Yakima, Washington, home. The case, which begins with what seems to be a simple burglary, spirals into a complex investigation exposing a tangled web of betrayal, deception, and fatal obsession.

videos.title: Poison Twist
videos.overview: Kaitlyn Conley was convicted of manslaughter in 2017 after the death of Mary Yoder by poison. Conley maintains she is innocent and continues her fight to overturn the conviction.

videos.title: Deadly Obsession
videos.overview: Mike Sisco and his fiancé Karen Harkness are found shot to death in their Topeka duplex in 2002. A years-long search for the killer and three criminal trials over two decades reveals strained dynamics within one victim’s family.

videos.title: The Last Mile
videos.overview: On July 18, 2018, Mollie Tibbetts, a 20-year-old University of Iowa student, disappears while jogging near her home in Brooklyn, Iowa. Investigators discover security camera video that reveals a critical clue.

videos.title: The Widow of Woodland Hills
videos.overview: Celebrity hairdresser Fabio Sementilli is brutally murdered in his backyard. A security camera helps investigators identify unlikely suspects and an illicit affair.

videos.title: The Pin at Apartment 210
videos.overview: 22-year-old Jasmine "Jazzy" Pace, a young Tennessee woman, mysteriously vanishes and misses her family's Thanksgiving dinner. Determined to track her down, her family takes matters into their own hands, pursuing every digital clue she left behind. What begins as a missing persons report evolves into a disturbing and calculated murder investigation.

videos.title: The Devil’s in the Details
videos.overview: A West Virginia pharmacist is left widowed after her husband, 38-year-old Michael Cochran, suddenly dies. Their close-knit neighborhood rallies around the family until troubling details emerge regarding the couple's new business venture.

videos.title: Murder in Minot
videos.overview: College student Anita Knutson is found stabbed to death. The case took years and the unwavering commitment of loved ones and investigators to reach a resolution.

videos.title: Secrets of the Sliding Door
videos.overview: Simeonette Mapes-Crupi, a beloved Staten Island teacher, is found dead in the home she shared with her husband.

videos.title: The Terrible Night on King Road
videos.overview: In the early morning hours of November 13, 2022, four University of Idaho students were killed in an off-campus rental house on King Road in Moscow, Idaho. See never-before-reported evidence, including video, photographic, and digital materials that investigators say track accused killer Bryan Kohberger’s movements.

videos.title: Sean Combs on Trial
videos.overview: Correspondent Josh Mankiewicz reports on the charges against Combs, which include a five-count federal indictment for racketeering and sex trafficking.

videos.title: Center of the Storm
videos.overview: Andrea Canning reports on the verdict in the retrial of Karen Read in Dedham, Massachusetts.

videos.title: Sean Combs: The Insiders Speak
videos.overview: New interviews and exclusive details following the Sean "Diddy" Combs trial.

videos.title: Secrets of Exam Room 9
videos.overview: When Angela Craig, a healthy mother of six, dies suddenly after an apparent medical illness, her community is stunned. As investigators dig deeper, suspicion shifts to her husband James, a respected local dentist and member of the LDS church.

videos.title: The Night of the Audition
videos.overview: After newlywed Shannon Madill Burgess does not show up for a family gathering after landing a big audition, her loved ones begin to worry, and authorities uncover unsettling details.

videos.title: The Betrayal of Sandra Birchmore
videos.overview: A February nor'easter closes a Boston-area elementary school; when it reopens, 23-year-old teacher’s aide Sandra Birch more never returns and is found dead in her home days later. Investigators rule the death a suicide, but was it something far more sinister?
